description: Curated manifest of public-domain LibriVox audiobooks used to seed the SideShelf demo Audiobookshelf server. Every 'identifier' is a verified archive.org identifier (see README.md for how verification is run). Do not add an identifier that has not been confirmed to resolve at https://archive.org/metadata/<identifier> with a non-empty MP3 file list. 'mode' controls how many audio files are downloaded per entry, which in turn controls how many chapters the item ends up with (Audiobookshelf derives one chapter per audio file): 'full' downloads every chapter file archive.org publishes (used for the handful of titles that anchor chapter-list / chapter-jump / sleep-timer screenshots); 'sample' downloads the first SAMPLE_CHAPTER_COUNT (4, see src/fetch-media.mjs) chapter files, so every other title still gets a real, presentable multi-chapter list instead of a single track; 'first-chapter' (one file) is kept working as a legacy alias for old manifests but is no longer used by any entry below — a single-file item has zero derivable chapters, which is unusable for screenshots. Chapter titles are set from archive.org's per-file 'title' metadata by demo-server/seed.mjs, not left as the raw filename.

entries.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
entries.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
entries.description: Twelve early cases narrated by Dr. Watson, including "A Scandal in Bohemia" and "The Red-Headed League", that introduced Holmes's methods to the reading public.

entries.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
entries.title: The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes
entries.description: A further set of Holmes investigations, first published in 1893, that ends with the detective's fateful encounter at the Reichenbach Falls.

entries.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
entries.title: The Return of Sherlock Holmes
entries.description: Holmes reappears after his presumed death to resume his practice, in thirteen stories collected in 1905.

entries.author: L. Frank Baum
entries.title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
entries.description: Dorothy and her dog Toto are swept from Kansas to the magical land of Oz, where they set off down a road of yellow brick to find a way home.

entries.author: L. Frank Baum
entries.title: The Marvelous Land of Oz
entries.description: The 1904 sequel to the Wizard of Oz, in which the boy Tip and his companions journey to the Emerald City amid a rebellion against the Scarecrow's rule.

entries.author: L. Frank Baum
entries.title: Ozma of Oz
entries.description: Dorothy is swept overboard in a storm and washes up in Ev, a land bordering Oz, where she meets Princess Ozma and the Nome King.

entries.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
entries.title: Anne of Green Gables
entries.description: An orphan girl is sent by mistake to a middle-aged brother and sister on Prince Edward Island who wanted a boy to help on their farm.

entries.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
entries.title: Anne of Avonlea
entries.description: Anne Shirley, now sixteen, takes up a teaching post in her home village of Avonlea in this 1909 sequel.

entries.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
entries.title: Anne of the Island
entries.description: Anne leaves Prince Edward Island for college, navigating friendship, ambition, and romance in this 1915 installment.

entries.author: Mark Twain
entries.title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
entries.description: A boy's adventures along the Mississippi River, including a whitewashed fence, a graveyard oath, and a hunt for buried treasure.

entries.author: Mark Twain
entries.title: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
entries.description: Huck Finn escapes his abusive father and rafts down the Mississippi with Jim, an enslaved man fleeing for his freedom.

entries.author: Jane Austen
entries.title: Pride and Prejudice
entries.description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates manners, marriage, and misjudgment as she comes to reconsider the proud Mr. Darcy.

entries.author: Bram Stoker
entries.title: Dracula
entries.description: Told through letters and diaries, a Transylvanian count's journey to England pits Jonathan Harker and Van Helsing against an ancient evil.

entries.author: Mary Shelley
entries.title: Frankenstein
entries.description: Victor Frankenstein's creation of life from dead matter leads to tragedy for both creator and creature in this 1818 novel.

entries.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
entries.title: Treasure Island
entries.description: Young Jim Hawkins sets sail with a map, a sea cook named Long John Silver, and a crew that turns out to be pirates.

entries.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
entries.title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
entries.description: A London lawyer investigates the disturbing connection between the respectable Dr. Jekyll and the violent Mr. Hyde.

entries.author: H. G. Wells
entries.title: The Time Machine
entries.description: A Victorian inventor travels far into the future, finding a world divided between the gentle Eloi and the subterranean Morlocks.

entries.author: H. G. Wells
entries.title: The War of the Worlds
entries.description: Martian tripods lay waste to the English countryside in one of the earliest and most influential alien-invasion stories.

entries.author: Lewis Carroll
entries.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
entries.description: Alice follows a White Rabbit down a hole into a world of nonsensical logic, a Mad Hatter, and a bad-tempered Queen of Hearts.

entries.author: Herman Melville
entries.title: Moby Dick
entries.description: Sailor Ishmael joins Captain Ahab's obsessive hunt for the white whale that took his leg.

entries.author: Charles Dickens
entries.title: A Christmas Carol
entries.description: The miser Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three spirits on Christmas Eve who show him his past, present, and possible future.

entries.author: Charles Dickens
entries.title: Great Expectations
entries.description: An orphan named Pip comes into an unexpected fortune and must reckon with who it has made him become.

entries.author: Oscar Wilde
entries.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
entries.description: A young man's portrait ages and bears the marks of his sins while he himself remains unchanged, in Wilde's only novel.

entries.author: Jack London
entries.title: The Call of the Wild
entries.description: A domesticated dog named Buck is stolen and sold into the brutal life of an Alaskan sled team during the Klondike Gold Rush.

entries.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
entries.title: A Princess of Mars
entries.description: Civil War veteran John Carter wakes on Mars, where lesser gravity makes him formidable and a dying world is at war.

entries.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
entries.title: The Gods of Mars
entries.description: John Carter returns to Barsoom and lands in the Valley Dor, a supposed paradise that guards a murderous secret.

entries.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
entries.title: The Warlord of Mars
entries.description: A pursuit across the frozen north of Mars to rescue Dejah Thoris and settle the fate of a divided planet.

entries.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
entries.title: Tarzan of the Apes
entries.description: Orphaned on the African coast and raised by apes, a nobleman's son grows up between two worlds.

entries.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
entries.title: The Return of Tarzan
entries.description: Tarzan tries life among Parisian society, then finds his way back to the jungle and a lost city of gold.

entries.author: Louisa May Alcott
entries.title: Little Women
entries.description: The four March sisters grow up in genteel poverty during the Civil War, sustained by each other and their ambitions.

entries.author: Louisa May Alcott
entries.title: Little Men
entries.description: Jo and her husband run Plumfield, a school where a dozen boys are educated as much by kindness as by lessons.

entries.author: Louisa May Alcott
entries.title: Jo's Boys
entries.description: The Plumfield boys are grown, and Jo watches them make their way in a world that has moved on without her.

entries.author: Rudyard Kipling
entries.title: The Jungle Book
entries.description: Mowgli is raised by wolves and taught the Law of the Jungle by a bear and a panther, with a tiger waiting.

entries.author: Rudyard Kipling
entries.title: The Second Jungle Book
entries.description: More of Mowgli's life among the wolves, and further tales from the jungle and the frozen north.
